purpose: Teach: 身勝手/行き届い/正気/脱帽/つまっ/のぞく/使いこなす/築き上げ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは身勝手と無縁の方だった
lines.en: When you were young, your father was never selfish.
lines.style: Soft, remembering tone. Pause slightly on the opening — settling into the memory. Slow, deliberate pace. Eyes distant. Slight warmth underneath the wistfulness, like holding something precious and fragile.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、家事まで行き届いてらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — he took such care with everything around the house, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle agreement, almost co-remembering. Warm, intimate tone — she's inviting him deeper into the memory with her. Soft on the closing endearment. Fingers might flutter slightly, as if touching something from long ago.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、戦争で正気を保つのが困難だった
lines.en: When you were young, it was hard for him to keep his mind steady, with the war.
lines.style: Voice quieter now. The memory shifts — less warm, more weighted. Pause before 'war' — it costs something to name it. Slow, respectful cadence, like speaking about something sacred and sorrowful at once.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様の努力に脱帽されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And I was so proud of him for managing it all — everything he accomplished.
lines.style: Her voice rises just slightly with recognition of his effort. Not proud of herself — proud *of him*. Firm but tender. The 'dear' comes softer, almost a benediction. She's defending him now, gently.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、引き出しが手紙でつまってた
lines.en: When you were young, his drawers were stuffed full of letters he'd written.
lines.style: Voice softens further. The pace is almost hesitant — this detail matters in a way he's still processing. Slight tremor of vulnerability. He's trusting her with something intimate. Gentle trailing-off at the end, like he's inviting her into what those letters might have held.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、書斎をのぞくのが好きだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You used to love peeking into his study, didn't you?
lines.style: A small, knowing smile in the voice — she remembers him as a younger man too. Warm, conspiratorial. The question isn't really a question. Intimate and close, like she's stroking his hair. Ends on a soft landing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが新技術を使いこなすのに時間がかかった
lines.en: When you were young, it took him time to master all the new things in the world.
lines.style: Acknowledging limitation without judgment. Measured, accepting tone. He's not defending his father — he's understanding him. Steady pace. A hint of sadness, but also love in the acceptance. Voice settles on 'time' — the gentleness of patience.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、人生で多くを築き上げてこられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And yet he built so much in his life — so much that mattered.
lines.style: Her voice brightens just slightly, insisting on the sum of it all. Not dismissing the struggles, but rebalancing the weight. Warm close, almost tucking him in with the words. The 'dear' is barely audible — a breath of tenderness. She's giving him permission to be proud.
